name: scamshield-ai-root
description: Multimodal AI-Powered Fraud Detection & Digital Protection Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "ML,SERVER,CLIENT" -c "magenta,blue,cyan" "npm run dev:ml" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "ML,SERVER,CLIENT" -c "magenta,blue,cyan" "npm run dev:ml" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.clean:ports: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000, 8000, 5173 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.OwningProcess -gt 4 } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; exit 0"
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
